title: Maria; Or, The Wrongs of Woman
sourceTitle: Maria; Or, The Wrongs of Woman
author: Mary Wollstonecraft
description: "Maria; Or, The Wrongs of Woman" by Mary Wollstonecraft is a novel written in the late 18th century.
longDescription: This work serves as a poignant exploration of the injustices faced by women in a patriarchal society, narrated through the experiences of the protagonist, Maria, a woman who finds herself imprisoned both physically and emotionally. The book delves into themes of motherhood, oppression, and the struggle for agency in a world that often dismisses women's rights.

authorInfo.bio: Mary Wollstonecraft 27 April 1759 – 10 September 1797) was an English writer and philosopher best known for her advocacy of women's rights. Until the late twentieth century, Wollstonecraft's life, which encompassed several unconventional personal relationships, received more attention than her writing. Wollstonecraft is regarded as one of the founding feminist philosophers, and feminists often cite both her life and her works as important influences.
